review_notes.evidence: RX021 1B D05 to 2A route native.png shows the D05 output bending upward on a separate vertical into 2A D05; the 1B upper blank wedge runs horizontally into 2B upper OR input. Both cross intervening rails without a printed junction diamond.

RX021 1C upper into 4C native.png shows the upper plain output of 1C extending into the blank upper input of 4C. RX021 1G upper B08 fork detail native.png shows a visible gap where the upper 1G route crosses its B08-to-2G B12 route, so no junction is inferred. RX021 1M B13 to 2M B03 native.png shows the B13-to-B03 route crossing a distinct vertical rail without a diamond.

RX021 1C B13 to 2D D02 native.png (crop name was provisional; print reads B02) shows 1C B13 crossing the adjacent rails, turning down at c69, and entering 2D at B02 on row26. The crossings lack source diamonds.

RX021 c67 lower source gate context.png shows 1E D02 bending up at c67. RX021 4A D06 top source rails high.png and RX021 4A D06 source upper full.png show that c67 rail continuing over the top row, down at c84, then right into 4A D06. It crosses the distinct top DP line and 2A D05 at unjoined crosses.

RX021 1M B13 branch to 4L lower native.png shows two distinct 1M outputs: the upper blank wire bends upward into the long row77 RESET HOLD route to the blank lower input of 4L; the B13 wire at row82 goes to 2M B03. Their crossing of the nearby vertical dashed line has no diamond.

review_notes.location: 1G upper output into 4G lower RESET HOLD wire
review_notes.evidence: RX021 2G gate all ports upper lower.png shows the 1G upper AR output descending at c68, crossing the B08-to-2G B12 wire without a diamond, and running under the 2G R TO box rather than out of its side. RX021 2G output to 4G lower native.png shows that same under-box wire rising at c84 into the unlabelled lower input of 4G, with RESET HOLD printed beneath it.
RX021 2B B05 to 3B D05 native.png shows the output bending upward after B05 and entering 3B at its D05 input; the lower D09 vertical rails and 2D10 branch remain distinct.

RX021 2E B02 to 3F D06 rail.png and RX021 2E B02 to 3F D06 below.png show the B02 output bending down along the leftmost c88 dashed rail and then right into 3F D06. At the D09 and 2D10 rows it crosses separate conductors without diamonds.

RX021 1K upper into 2K native.png and RX021 2K N native inputs full.png show the unlabeled 1K upper output bending down to the unlabeled triangle input at 2K. The separate D04 output bends down farther and is not joined here.

RX021 1K to right lower routes.png, RX021 1K D04 lower bend.png, and RX021 2N full native and row89 origin.png show the D04 output turning down at c66 and entering 2N at its B07 triangle input on row89. RX021 1K D04 YIASC junction high.png shows the rail crossing +YIASC at row72 as a dark solid cross, without the open diamond used elsewhere for a join. The crossing remains separate pending an independent native check.
RX021 2K B03 to 3K D05 candidate.png shows the printed B03 output bending down at the leftmost c89 bank-3 rail, then right into the 3K D05 input. The c90 and c91 dashed conductors remain distinct.

RX021 bank3 native upper gates ports.png and RX021 bank3 native lower gates ports.png show the six 3B/3D/3F/3H/3K/3M gate input labels and blank right output strokes. The nearby B07, B12, and E07 labels at 3D, 3H, and 3M attach to separate vertical wires that bend right below their gate boxes, not to their input boundaries; these remain unassigned bypass routes. Connected sources of the remaining inputs are still under review.
RX021 3B output toward 5C native.png shows the unlabelled 3B output crossing over 4C, turning downward just left of 5C, and entering 5C at its upper blank OR input.

review_notes.location: 3F and 3K to bank 5 OR upper inputs
review_notes.evidence: RX021 3F output toward 5G native.png and RX021 3K output toward 5L native.png show the corresponding output strokes bending down into the upper blank OR inputs of 5G and 5L.

review_notes.location: 3D and 3M to bank 5 OR lower inputs
review_notes.evidence: RX021 3D into 5C lower path broad.png and RX021 3M to 5L lower native.png each show a continuous output stroke from the A gate, rightward across bank 4, then upward on the c130 rail into the lower blank input of the adjacent bank-5 OR gate. The paired bank-4 dashed rail crossings have no diamonds. The similar 3H-to-5G path has a visible break and remains unassigned.

review_notes.location: bank 4 A to bank 5 OR middle inputs
review_notes.evidence: RX021 4C output into 5C native.png, RX021 4G output into 5G native.png, and RX021 4L output into 5L native.png each show a direct rightward wire through printed 6 into the OR gate middle input.

RX021 bank4 A all terminals native.png and RX021 4L SCAN A ports native.png show three physical input wires per SCAN A gate. 4C has blank upper, D07 middle, 2D10 lower; 4G has 2D10 upper, D07 middle, blank lower; 4L has 2D10 upper, D07 middle, blank lower. The adjacent vertical dashed rails and two diamond marks at 4L are not an extra input.

RX021 3H output break native high.png shows a visible printed gap at the paired pre-4G vertical rails between the 3H output stroke and the rightward 5G lower stroke. This is not silently bridged in the net graph; physical connectivity remains under source review.

RX021 YIASC left.png and RX021 YIASC bank1-3.png show the RX001CL4 +YIASC continuation across row72. RX021 YIASC bank3-5.png and RX021 YIASC to c113 open junction high.png show it entering a hollow diamond on c113, immediately left of the distinct c114 2D10 diamond. The c113 rail feeds 4C, 4G, and 4L D07. RX021 c113 c114 below 4L to clock.png shows its row75 D07 branch crossing c114 without a hollow diamond. The +YIASC rail also crosses 1K D04 at c66 without a hollow join; an independent native review remains pending.

review_notes.location: 2J D07 c114 rail to +CLOCK P4 GATE
review_notes.evidence: RX021 c113 c114 below 4L to clock.png and RX021 c113 c114 into clock P4 bend high.png show the c114 reset-hold rail, distinct from the c113 +YIASC/D07 rail, continuing down from 4L 2D10 and bending right on row86. RX021 lower outgoing middle.png and RX021 lower outgoing right.png follow that line to RX051 +CLOCK P4 GATE. The nearby 3H output gap remains unbridged.

RX021 c114 break at 5G lower detail.png shows the second bank-4 vertical continuing through row54 and an attached rightward T branch into the 5G lower input after it bends upward at c130. The distinct 3H output terminates before c113 to its left; it is not assigned to 5G lower. This T branch is provisionally linked to the already traced c114 2D10 rail, pending final native review.

review_notes.location: bank 5 OR fan-outs into paired bank 6 N gates
review_notes.evidence: RX021 5C D04 to bank6 native.png, RX021 5G D12 to bank6 native.png, and RX021 5L D04 to bank6 native.png each show a printed junction diamond at the outgoing test-point-labelled wire, with one branch rising to the higher N gate and one continuing to the lower N gate.

RX021 row87 c156 upper1.png and RX021 row87 c156 upper2.png follow the 5C D04T bank-6 fanout rail down c156 through unjoined crossings. This route was missing from the earlier raster-backed draft and is now explicit.

review_notes.location: left margin into bank 1 and bank 3
review_notes.evidence: RX021 left inputs upper native.png, RX021 left inputs middle native.png, and RX021 left inputs lower native.png show all six labelled ROSLTH/FORCE source lines ending at their literal 1B/1C/1E/1G/1K/1M terminals. The three ROSLTH lines have separate DS401 references feeding their visible diamond at c43. The inhibit and blocked-clock continuations reach 3F D09 and 3H 2D02 respectively across the page.

RX021 clock row52 full native.png shows the RX003CH4 line reaching 3H 2D02, with printed diamonds at c69 and c90; these two vertical branches are still being traced, so this net remains source_reviewed false.

RX021 clock c90 to 3M.png follows the same c90 dashed conductor from the row52 blocked-clock diamond down to its right bend into the 3M 2D02 input at row80. Horizontal crossings without diamonds remain distinct.

review_notes.location: top DS041AH4 and blocked-clock vertical rails
review_notes.evidence: RX021 top DP route into 2B native.png and RX021 2B D09 physical x native.png place the DP TO ROSAR 0 1 rail at c68, with source diamonds at the 2B and 2E D09 inputs. RX021 DP rail rows14-40 native.png shows that rail ending at 2E D09. RX021 bank6 to7 upper native.png and RX021 bank7 B07 B12 rail gap native.png show the 6C B07 output joining the c184 vertical at row19, reaching 7A B07, 7D B07, and 7E B12 with printed diamonds at rows19, 26, and 33. RX021 bank7 c184 row33-58 native.png and RX021 c184 right row44 native.png show the same rail bending right at row44 into -ROSAR 0 EQ 0, with a diamond at c203. The adjacent c183 rail remains separate; the right reference branch still needs typography review.

RX021 3D B07 route full gate.png shows the printed B07 label attached to a vertical bypass west of 3D, not an input of 3D. RX021 3D B07 bypass destination native.png and RX021 3D B07 row33 east destination.png show this conductor running east on row33 through the c184 diamond into 7E B12. It crosses the c113 bank-4 D07 rail without a diamond. The B07 stub has no native driver box and is retained as a visible spur of the already traced 6C B07 rail rather than invented as a 3D input.

RX021 6G B12 to 7H native.png and RX021 6G B12 rail bottom native.png show a distinct c183 rail from 6G B12 through the 7H B12 diamond to the row72 right continuation. At 7J B07 the rail crosses without a printed diamond, so that input is not assigned to 6G.

RX021 6F D11 to right row43 full.png shows the test-point-marked D11 output bending down c182 to row45, crossing c183/c184 without diamonds, and then rising at c199 past the row44 -ROSAR 0 EQ 0 line without a diamond to the row43 RX211 +ROSAR 1 EQ 1 continuation. RX021 6F D11 rail endpoint native.png confirms the two adjacent right lines stay separate.

review_notes.evidence: RX021 3B D09 c89 upper rail native.png, RX021 inhibit row38 bank3 rail native.png, and RX021 inhibit c89 to 3K D09 native.png show the RX001GD4 inhibit line joining c89 at its row38 diamond, with that rail reaching 3B D09 above and 3K D09 below. review_notes.status: Private complete native-source transcription candidate: all 43 native function boxes and their 60 printed input terminals are entered with explicit source-traced wires. The raster wire guide is excluded from the render. Native-to-clean comparison found and corrected footer labels, right references, heading text, caption tails, bank-5 bottom rails, and bypass rows 34/62. The 3H row54 output has a real physical gap and is retained source-open; isolated lower-right continuation hooks are likewise preserved without invented drivers. Root acceptance and any canonical publication remain separate.

review_notes.location: lower-left connector table and top-left continuation
review_notes.evidence: RX021 footer connector left high.png and RX021 footer connector right high.png show nine left connector rows and three right wrap rows at 94-102, corroborated by RX021 A1 connector references. RX021 top left continuation high.png shows the unspaced -J102+103◇9020 DP TO ROSAR 0 1-DS041AH4 sequence followed by the wire. Both areas are explicit text in the source-only render.

RX021 c184 right row44 native.png shows the KK011 reference branch beneath the -ROSAR 0 EQ 0 diamond and KK101 beneath its label. RX021 c182 row89 continuation native.png likewise shows KK011 and KU231 beneath -ROSAR 2 EQ 0. RX021 native bottom references root broad.png resolves the first left-side reference beneath the row83 -ROSAR 1 EQ 1 continuation as KK011, distinct from its right-side KU231 companion. RX021 c199 c200 bottom route discrimination.png shows the right row83 and row85 label strokes as short isolated hooks and the row84 KK011 diamond reference as a separate visible stroke, with no continuous native source from the lower bank-5 rails. Those three strokes are preserved as source-open rather than tied to adjacent nets.

RX021 overview.png and RX021 heading NORMAL SCAN ROSAR top.png show the repeated native NORMAL, RESET HOLD, SCAN, ROSAR 0/1/2, P4 GATE, and SPARE headings immediately above their respective boxes. They are explicit source text in the clean render.

RX021 overview.png and RX021 right lower continuations native.png show a printed horizontal dash tail between each right-side signal caption and its margin connector ID. These fourteen tails are now explicit strokes in the source-only render.

RX021 bank5 c155 c160 lower route high.png follows the c155 5G D12T rail to row90 and c160 5L D04T rail to row88. RX021 c199 lower route bends exact.png shows their short isolated upturned hooks at c200 row90 and c199 row88, respectively. Neither hook joins the adjacent row89 or row87 signal; no continuation destination is inferred. These long native strokes were absent from the earlier clean render.

The native RX021 TIFF has a full-width bypass stroke at y=2337 and y=4008 around x=4450-4900. Grid anchors put these at printer rows 34 and 62, respectively, one row below the 7E B12 row33 and 7J B07 row61 input terminals. RX021 3D B07 row33 east destination.png and RX021 3H B12 row61 east destination.png show the separate lower diamonds at c184 and c182. Earlier crop names called these row33/61 provisionally; the clean source-only render now uses the measured rows 34/62.
